purpose: Same 5-day holding question as multiday-1, but on LARGER, more liquid stocks (above the Alpaca small/mid-cap liquidity cap). Historical, daily bars, local, long-only, development period only.
data: Same local daily bars as multiday-1 (research/round2/data/daily, incl. delisted symbols). No new downloads.

periods.rule: The locked period is not downloaded or analysed unless a hypothesis passes development.

universe.advDefinition: mean(close*volume) of the 20 sessions ending at signal day t
universe.pick: all eligible stocks (no volatility ranking, there are only a few hundred per day)

execution.missingBars: censored and counted; delisted symbols exit at last available close

costs.note: Large liquid stocks: 0.05% per side primary (spread plus slippage).

M1.name: continuation after a strong volume day
M1.rule: return(t) >= +4%, volume(t) >= 2 x mean volume of the previous 20 sessions, close in the top quarter of the day's range

M2.name: short-term reversal after a sharp drop
M2.rule: return(t) <= -4%, volume(t) >= 2 x mean volume of the previous 20 sessions

M3.name: 20-day high breakout
M3.rule: close(t) > max high of the previous 20 sessions, volume(t) >= 1.5 x mean volume of the previous 20 sessions, return(t) >= +1.5%

thresholdNote: Thresholds are the multiday-1 thresholds halved (8% -> 4%, 3% -> 1.5%) because large stocks move less. Fixed now, not varied after results. The original multiday-1 thresholds are run as a descriptive line only and do not enter the tests.
control: per day, 5 random stocks from the same universe (seeded sha256 order), same entry and exit

inference.statistic: mean over dates of (picks mean net return - control mean net return)
inference.test: date-block circular bootstrap, blocks of 20 dates, 2000 resamples, one-sided p for mean <= 0
inference.passRule: Holm p < 0.05 AND excess > 0 AND absolute net mean > 0 AND at least 100 trades AND at least 2 of 3 calendar years with positive net mean

noTuning: Nothing above is varied after seeing results.
